items.docs: Gets a list of payment purpose codes for a given currency and entity type. When initiating cross-border payments, the central bank of the country may require a purpose to be included with your transaction in order for your payment to be accepted and processed. If a payment purpose code is required but not provided, your payment may be delayed or rejected by the beneficiary bank.
